completion:
Clearly list the specific section of the building.
3. Note the date and time of the inspection.
4. Provide the names and qualifications of the inspectors.
5. Identify the standard or regulation that was not met.
6. Record each specific violation with detailed descriptions. Include digital photos or sketches if possible.
7. Give the location within the building where the issue was found.
8. Describe how the non-compliance affects accessibility.
9. If possible, provide suggestions for rectifying the issue.
10. Document any communication with the building owner or management.
11. Include a summary of the findings.
12. Make note of whether the violations are new or recurring issues.
13. Record any mitigating circumstances (e.g., temporary construction that blocks access).
14. List any immediate corrective actions that were taken, if applicable.
15. Add information on follow-up inspections scheduled.
